name: LilyGo T-Beam / LoRa32 v2.1, Heltec v2 (SX127x)
note: SX127x boards accept up to 17 dBm. This covers the LilyGo T-Beam and LoRa32 v2.1.

name: RAK4631, Heltec v3, LilyGo T3S3 (SX1262)
note: Bare SX1262 boards accept up to 22 dBm.

name: Heltec LoRa32 v4 (SX1262 + external PA)
note: The v4 carries an external PA rated to 28 dBm (PA_MAX_OUTPUT in the firmware's Boards.h). This figure applies to no other board.

name: 2.4 GHz board (SX1280)
note: Bare SX1280 accepts up to 13 dBm.

name: 2.4 GHz board with PA (SX1280 + PA)
note: SX1280 with an external PA accepts up to 20 dBm.

name: Not sure / other board
note: 17 dBm is the safe value: every RNode-supported radio accepts it. Raise it once you know what your board is.
